# ==============================================================================
# PROJECT CASTOR: WORKLOAD FOUNDATION - IAM & SERVICE ACCOUNTS
# ==============================================================================
# Configures least-privilege IAM bindings for GitHub Actions deployment and
# the workload's runtime execution identity.
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CI/CD Deployer Service Account Roles
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "google_project_iam_member" "deployer_editor" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/editor"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.github_deployer.email}"
}

resource "google_project_iam_member" "deployer_run_admin" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/run.admin"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.github_deployer.email}"
}

resource "google_project_iam_member" "deployer_artifact_admin" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/artifactregistry.admin"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.github_deployer.email}"
}

resource "google_project_iam_member" "deployer_sa_user" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/iam.serviceAccountUser"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.github_deployer.email}"
}

resource "google_project_iam_member" "deployer_build_editor" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/cloudbuild.builds.editor"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.github_deployer.email}"
}

resource "google_project_iam_member" "deployer_storage_admin" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/storage.admin"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.github_deployer.email}"
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Workload Runtime Service Account & Scoped Permissions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "google_service_account" "workload_sa" {
  project      = var.project_id
  account_id   = "sa-${substr(replace(var.product_id, "_", "-"), 0, 20)}"
  display_name = "Runtime Service Account for ${var.product_id}"
}

resource "google_project_iam_member" "workload_datastore_user" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/datastore.user"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.workload_sa.email}"
}

resource "google_project_iam_member" "workload_log_writer" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/logging.logWriter"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.workload_sa.email}"
}

resource "google_project_iam_member" "workload_pubsub_publisher" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/pubsub.publisher"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.workload_sa.email}"
}

resource "google_project_iam_member" "workload_storage_user" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = "roles/storage.objectUser"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.workload_sa.email}"
}
